args.summary:
Delivered a 2D spine-beam FE model of a 3-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder bridge (36 + 48 + 36 m, deck width 16 m), built and verified in OpenSeesPy via the bridge KG.

Structure: single-cell cast_box section (B_top 16 m, B_bot 9 m, h 2.4 m, webs 0.45 m, cantilevers 0.5→0.2 m), integrated section properties A = 8.417 m², I = 7.188 m⁴ (I from exact outline-minus-cavity integration). C50 girder, Ec = 34 500 MPa, γ = 26 kN/m³, self-weight only, w = 218.84 kN/m, m = 22.31 t/m. System = continuous_on_piers (both interior supports sit on modelled twin-column piers); idealization spine_beam_2d.

Supports: abutments 0 & 3 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (2× 400×500, 5×11 mm, Ge = 1.2 MPa), longitudinally free; pier 1 = plain laminated elastomeric (fixed, 2× 600×700, 7×11 mm) with Kh spring; pier 2 = PTFE sliding (2× 550×650, 6×11 mm). Bearings modelled as zero-length springs: Kv from JTG 3362-2018 §8.7 (Ee = 5.4GeS², Eb = 2000 MPa) → 3.61e6 / 8.97e6 / 8.08e6 / 3.61e6 kN/m; Kh = 13 091 kN/m at pier 1, 0 elsewhere. Piers: twin Ø1.6 m C40 columns, A = 4.021 m², I = 0.643 m⁴, H = 8 m and 11 m, Ec = 32 500 MPa.

Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 4 design lanes, ξ = 0.67, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 332/356/332 kN, impact μ = 0.177 (from f1 = 2.980 Hz, JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Results: first three vertical frequencies 2.980 / 4.761 / 5.479 Hz; self-weight support reactions 2835 / 10302 / 10281 / 2843 kN; lane-load peak positive moment 14 357 kN·m and peak negative (pier) moment −11 480 kN·m. Model passed L1/L2/L3 checks. No unresolved issues.
